name: Oblique Strategies

script.text: on openStackhide titleBarset userlevel to 1visual effect dissolvewait 1 secondgo card 2end openStack
on mouseUpvisual effect dissolve slowlyput the random of 127 into randomcardVaradd 3 to randomcardVargo to card randomcardVarend mouseUp
on mouseUpvisual effect wipe left very slowlyif the number of this card is 130¬or the number of this card is 2 thengo card 4elsego next cardend ifend mouseUp
on mouseUpvisual effect wipe right very slowlyif the number of this card is 4¬or the number of this card is 2 thengo last cardelsego previous cardend ifend mouseUp
on mouseUpvisual effect dissolve slowlygo card 2end mouseUp
on mouseUpanswer "Leave Oblique Strategies?" with "No" or "Yes"if the value of it is "yes" thendoMenu "Quit HyperCard"end ifend mouseUp
on mouseUpvisual effect dissolve very slowlygo to card 3end mouseUp
